notes.title: MacOS version is already available!
notes.notes:
The version of the game for MacOS is already loaded into Steam and it works. The system requirements are the most loyal - so it's time to try the State Department Agent: Mission in Russia!

In addition, a small bug was fixed and the translation into English was slightly improved.

notes.title: Major update! + 30% in-game content. +French translation
notes.notes:
We just released an update - now game have +30% of content!
- 6 completely new player cards
- 4 player cards completely redone
- 10 completely new government cards
A number of texts have also been fixed.
Thanks for your feedback and for your support! It means a lot to us.

A quality French translation has also been added. We are currently working on German. It will be available early next week.
